verdict.rationale: Databricks Connect and dbt Core let you code locally in your IDE, but both still execute against live Databricks cloud compute rather than a free/local engine or sandbox — there is no evidence of an offline emulator, local Spark runtime, or free dev-only environment that avoids touching production compute. Community comments (e.g. databricks-comm-5, databricks-comm-4) even highlight friction with local/serverless config work, reinforcing the gap.
